claims: System works with both Codex and Claude Code and can switch between them with one button
Runs Jev in the background as a request classifier because it is 'very fast, very cheap'
All requests go through Jev and are divided into tier 1, 2, 3 so each gets the appropriate model ('fast and cheap')
Has a fully local voice system and works inside Obsidian
'Real sell' of AIOS systems is that you can hand them to team members or sell them to clients
Built on top of a 'whole skill library'
how_to_steps: User gives the OS a command (voice via tap-to-talk, or text box 'Ask or continue...')
Request hits 'The Bridge' (one brain for both apps) which sends it to Jev

Jev classifies into: Tier 1 = rules + saved data, no AI, instant (e.g. 'what are my priorities?'); Tier 2 = quick answer from small fast model Haiku/Luna (e.g. 'summarize today's AI news'); Tier 3 = real work, opens a Claude Code or Codex terminal or runs a skill in the background
Tier 3 saves reports into 'The Vault' (plain markdown: daily notes, reports + research, conversations, receipts of every request) which the Obsidian plugin reads
Jarvis HUD web app in browser exposes same buttons and voice; skills quick-access: Plan Today, Inbox Brief, Deep Research, Content Cascade
Get the setup via the link in bio (paid community)
on_screen_only: Dashboard header 'AGENTIC OS V2' with tabs OVERVIEW / AUDIENCE / RESEARCH, stats 173K and 16.6M, 2%
Latest upload: 'GPT 6 Sol & Luna Are Here (And 50% CHEAPER)' 52.7K views 535 likes 44 comments
Day schedule items: Morning brief + inbox triage, Hack + title workshop, Demo prep, 'Script + outline: Jarvis HUD + Hologram', Chase AI+ Shoot post update, Thumbnail concepts, Editor handoff

Claude Code terminal: 'Fable 5.1 with high effort · Claude Max', '~\The Vault', warning '8 MCP servers need authentication · run /mcp', 'Get to finished work sooner with Opus 5.5. Switch anytime with /model', status line 'The Vault | Fable 5.1 | ctx: --'

Architecture diagram: Obsidian plugin (lives inside the vault, ears + dashboard + terminal tabs) -> THE BRIDGE (one brain for both apps, takes every request from both front doors) -> JEV (sorts each request into the right tier) -> Tier 1/2/3 -> saves reports -> THE VAULT: shared memory
Speech service: 'Whisper = ears · Kokoro = voice'; 'Jarvis HUD: web app in the browser, same buttons, same voice'
Astra HUD: 'GPT-6 Astra · Codex mode', states Idle / Listening / Working / Speaking / Error / Auto, 'V2 · Connected vault · Shared agent terminals', 'Shared with Obsidian'
Obsidian file tab '2026-09-23-intel' with Graph view
Skills quick access: Plan Today, Inbox Brief, Deep Research, Content Cascade, 'Browse all skills'; VOICE: 'Tap to talk · Whisper / Kokoro · local speech'
cta: Link in bio / check description to get the exact setup in 'chase ai+' (paid)

relevance.why: The tiered-routing pattern (rules -> cheap small model -> Claude Code for real work) and markdown vault as shared memory are directly applicable ideas for a solo founder running Claude Code; the product itself is a paid, heavy personal-OS build that a time-poor founder does not need.

implement_score.why: Not worth buying or replicating the whole OS. Worth stealing one idea: route trivial/lookup requests away from the expensive model and keep a plain-markdown vault that Claude Code writes reports into. Everything else (voice, HUD, Obsidian plugin) is days of yak-shaving.
